MOD = 1000000007

def modpow(base, exp):
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return result

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    q = k

    if k == 0:
        print(modpow(p, p - 1))
        return
    if k == 1:
        print(modpow(p, p))
        return

    n = 1
    while q != 1:
        q = (q * k) % p
        n += 1

    print(modpow(p, (p - 1) // n))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
